BiblicalUsage: maskîyl is an instructive psalm, a didactic poem, and it stands in the titles of thirteen psalms. It names the psalms of David and of the sons of Korah, of Asaph and of Ethan and of Heman, and the word itself is a promise that the song will teach. I have cited no verse for it here, because every occurrence stands in a psalm title rather than in the psalm's own lines.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe maskîyl teaches me that God gives instruction in song, and that a psalm can teach what a lecture cannot.
